messages:
julia: FYI vendor just updated — 60 of our H100s are on a mixed air+sea shipment and customs flagged the HS code. they want confirmation before releasing the air leg :grimacing:
amrith: which HS are they asking for? do we have our customs broker looped?
sarah_ops: vendor message attached, says 'HTS 8473.30 vs 8486.90' — seems like broker needs final ok. cc @ivan_rma for RMA and warranty tagging.
ivan_rma: thanks. on the RMA side we need serials tied to the air AWB. if customs holds the air crate we can't push loaners out. what's the ETA if we reroute full air?
ben_p: rerouting full air adds ~$45k + carrier change fees, but gets them here T+4 instead of T+18 by sea. partial air already paid for, vendor says they'd split docs but customs won't release without HS confirmation.
julia: cluster health: we're down ~12% usable capacity in us-west due to incoming DOA replacements awaiting this shipment. if we wait sea it bumps into next month capacity crunch. can we deploy temporary loaners from EU pool?
amrith: EU pool has ~8 available H100 loaners but cross-border loaners need temporary import docs and broker support — lead time ~48hrs to get customs pre-clear. that's still faster than re-airing?
sarah_ops: cost calc quick note: re-air + expedite customs = +$45k, temp loaner paperwork + crossdock = +$6k and 48-72h. recommend loaners unless customer SLA demands air.
ivan_rma: one wrinkle — a subset of these units had firmware mismatch flagged in inbound QA (vendor note). vendor will only swap if we accept refurbished replacements for those 6 units. we need sign-off from eng-runtime on acceptance criteria.
tarek: eng-runtime sign-off: refurbished ok if pass stress test for 72h and fw <= target rev. we can run staging soak.
ben_p: vendor offered to expedite RMA for the 6 fw-mismatch units separately (air) if we cover expedited fee. splits shipping manifest which complicates customs entries.
logistics-bot: Shipment update: AWB AIR: 125-444-998 (60 units partial), BOL SEA: CNTRL-7781 (rest of container). Insurance declared: $9,500,000.
julia: ok plan proposal: 1) approve temp loaners from EU pool to cover immediate capacity (amrith to approve cross-border docs) 2) accept vendor refurbished swap for the 6 after 72h soak (eng-runtime to run tests) 3) confirm HS code with broker as 8473.30 (gpu cards) and push vendor to update commercial invoice to match 4) vendor to air-expedite only the 6 fw-mismatch units if we cover the expedite fee (ben to negotiate)
amrith: i'll start import docs now and confirm broker tonight. if broker pushes back on HTS i'll loop customs agent.
ben_p: i'll push vendor for lower expedite fee and try consolidate AWBs to reduce customs filings. if they won't budge i'll cover expedite for critical 6.
sarah_ops: I'll prepare internal notes for capacity/schedule and mark nodes for drain/maintenance window Weds 02:00 UTC.
ivan_rma: send me serials list and vendor RMA IDs. I'll ensure warranty tags and update our asset db.
julia: serials attached in vendor csv. quick manifest extract:
```
AWB: 125-444-998
Items: H100-16GB x 60
Serials: H100-AB1234..H100-AB1293
Vendor RMA: VND-99821
```
ben_p: vendor just replied — they can change invoice HS to 8473.30 but will need 'end-use' attestation from us for air leg release.
amrith: that's standard. i'll get the attestation template signed by legal and send back today.
tarek: eng-runtime, will schedule soak for any refurbished arrivals immediately and share tests.
julia: great. next steps: amrith (import attestation + loaner clearance), ben (negotiate expedite + confirm final shipping plan), ivan (serial/RMA updates), sarah (maintenance window comms). i'll ping again when broker confirms HS acceptance. :thumbsup:
